title: webconsulting Redaktion: overview film
description: The actual macOS app with synthetic demo articles: focused writing, local drafts, offline continuation and deliberate TYPO3 publishing. Narrated, with selectable English captions.
alt: Overview film, 62 seconds: webconsulting Redaktion. Rich-text news editing, local drafts, offline continuation, content preview and native Mac shortcuts. Narrated, with selectable English captions.

transcript.text: You are halfway through a story when the connection drops.
Redaktion keeps your writing on your Mac. TYPO3 stays in charge of publishing.
Pick a news article, write in rich text, and keep the rest of the website out of your way.
Drafts save locally after a short pause. Previously loaded articles and drafts stay available after an offline restart.
Check the wording in preview. Saving sends it to your chosen TYPO3 workspace. Publication needs your explicit approval.
Native shortcuts, encrypted sessions, and light or dark mode. The same workspace also runs in the browser.
Redaktion, by webconsulting. Ask us for a demonstration.
